langTag.description: BCP 47 tag of this translation, used for <html lang> and number formatting. Not shown.

extDescription.message: Caste la vidéo de l'onglet vers le lecteur NetsuCast (upscale ArtCNN).

actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon. Keyboard shortcut as the OS shows it in this language.

commandDescription.message: Caster la vidéo de l'onglet vers NetsuCast

menuPlay.description: Right-click menu on a page, video or link.

menuPick.description: Right-click menu on the toolbar icon; opens the stream picker.

castDone.description: Success: toolbar icon tooltip and popup message after a cast.

castSending.description: In-page cast button label while the cast is being sent. Short.

castPlaying.description: In-page cast button label after a successful cast. Short.

errNoVideo.message: Vidéo introuvable : survole-la et clique sur son bouton NetsuCast
errNoVideo.description: Error: the page is a feed/channel, not one video. Shown in the in-page button and the icon tooltip.

errHttp.description: Error: the app answered with an HTTP error status.

errNotRunning.message: NetsuCast ne répond pas : lance l'application.
errNotRunning.description: Error: the app did not answer (not running). Icon tooltip and popup.

errNotRunningShort.description: Same as errNotRunning, short for the in-page button.

statusOff.description: Popup status: the app does not answer.

popupSendPage.description: Popup primary button: cast the page URL (resolved by yt-dlp).

popupNoPage.message: Aucune page web dans cet onglet.
popupNoPage.description: Popup hint when the tab is not a web page.

popupStreamsTitle.description: Popup section title: list of detected streams (HLS, DASH, MP4…).

popupEmpty.message: Aucun flux détecté. Lance la vidéo dans la page, puis rouvre ce menu.
popupEmpty.description: Popup empty state of the stream list.

popupPort.description: Popup label of the port field (local port of the app).

popupPlay.description: Popup button on each stream row: play this stream in the app.

setTitle.description: Popup: settings view title and the gear button's label.

menuSettings.description: Right-click menu on the toolbar icon; opens the extension settings.

setCastButton.description: Settings switch: show the cast button over videos in pages.

setButtonOnSite.description: Settings switch: show the button on the current site (hostname).

setIconClick.description: Settings: what a click on the toolbar icon does. Choices: setIconCast, setIconMenu.

setPauseOnCast.message: Mettre en pause la vidéo du navigateur

setSendPositionHint.message: NetsuCast démarre là où tu en étais dans le navigateur.

setContextMenu.description: Settings switch: the 'Play in NetsuCast' right-click entry (shown below as hint).

setPortHint.message: Le même que dans les paramètres de NetsuCast.
setPortHint.description: Hint under the port field: must match the port set in the app.

setHideFullscreen.message: Masquer le bouton en plein écran
